profiles.shortDescription: FIRMA "URLIŃSKI" is a Polish manufacturer of process machinery for pharmaceutical and cosmetic industry, with the address 04-987 Warszawa, ul. Wał Miedzeszyński 172, Polska. The site states that the company has been designing and manufacturing equipment for cosmetic and pharmaceutical products for more than thirty years and that it specializes in production of first-class quality homogenizing mixers. It also states that its equipment meets high pharmaceutical standards of FDA rules and is supplied together with IQ/QQ validation documentation, and that for client's request it carries out DQ, IQ and OQ qualification for validation of technological process.
fullDescription: The company's own account places its beginning in 1984: "All started in the eighties of last century, when the name of Urliński was not widely known in cosmetic industry. In 1984, the owner – Andrzej Urliński, started activity connected with process machinery production." The site adds that the company has been designing and manufacturing equipment for cosmetic and pharmaceutical products for more than thirty years, that currently export makes a half of its total production, and that Urliński company is one of the world leaders in the branch of process machinery for pharmaceutical and cosmetic industry. The address published on the site is 04-987 Warszawa, ul. Wał Miedzeszyński 172, Polska, and the contact page prints the company name as FIRMA "URLIŃSKI".

The published product programme is organised into a PHARMACY section and a COSMETICS section, the latter carrying the sub-labels DECORATIVE and CURATIVE. Named machines include HOMOGENIZING MIXERS TYPE MZUTL and HOMOGENIZING MIXERS TYPE MZUTS, LABORATORY HOMOGENIZING MIXER MZUTL 2, LABORATORY HOMOGENIZING MIXER TYPE MZUTL 5, TYPE MZUTL 10 CCF, TYPE MZUTL 15 CC and TYPE MZUTL 30, HOMOGENIZING MIXER TYPE MZUTL 50 and TYPE MZUTL 50 C, HOMOGENIZING MIXER WITH COVER LIFTING SYSTEM TYPE MZUTL 1000, MZUTL-H 50 CCF, PHARMACEUTICAL MIXER FOR LIQUID PRODUCTS TYPE MZUT 100, LABORATORY ASEPTIC PROCESS MIXER MM-ZUT 10 CCF, PROCESS MIXER WITH EMULSIFYING SYSTEM TYPE MS, MIXER TYPE MW-P 200 F, AUXILIARY FAT PHASE MIXER TYPE MZUT-EMBF 50, MIXER FOR POWDERS TYPE MP 12P, FILTRATION MIXER TYPE MF-L 40, MOBILE IN-LINE HOMOGENIZERS TYPE MHZ, STORAGE TANKS TYPE ZB WITH FIP PUMP, STORAGE TANK ZB 1000 ES, a MOBILE CIP STATION and a CIP-SIP docking station.

The site also presents complete process lines: PROCESS LINE FOR OINTMENT AND PHARMACEUTICAL EMULSIONS, PROCESS LINE FOR SUPPOSITORIES, PROCESS LINE FOR HIGH VISCOSITY PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS, COSMETIC PROCESS LINE FOR COMMERCIAL PRODUCTION and INDUSTRIAL PROCESS LINE FOR MANUFACTURING OF COSMETIC PRODUCTS ADAPTED TO WORK IN ZONE Ex. All mixers are stated to be designed and fabricated in conformity with the "scale-up" procedure allowing technologists to transfer the formula from laboratory devices to industrial ones, custom projects are offered for clients' individual requests, and operational panel control is applied from manual to fully automated including data recording. The company states that it offers complex solutions – full production lines according to GMP guidelines as well as technological support and stuff training.

profiles.shortDescription: Jaron Technologies LLC manufactures test equipment for the Carbon Black Producers and Carbon Black users market, and services and provides parts for carbon black test equipment. Its published instrument list covers a hydraulic press for the compressed OAN test, a mass strength tester, an individual pellet hardness tester, portable and multiple-station sieve residue testers and a void volume tester, built around ASTM carbon black test methods. The company also provides individual sample testing for Individual Pellet Hardness, Bulk Density, Sieve Residue Pellet Size Distribution and Void Volume.
fullDescription: Jaron Technologies LLC is a United States manufacturer of carbon black test equipment based at 2338 Duncan St, Pampa, Texas. The company describes its business as manufacturing test equipment for the Carbon Black Producers and Carbon Black users market, and it also services and provides parts for carbon black test equipment already in the field.

The published product list covers instruments built around ASTM carbon black test methods. It includes a Carbon Black Press, a hydraulic press used to crush carbon black for the Compressed OAN Test (ASTM D3493); a Mass Strength Tester used to measure the bulk transport properties of pelleted carbon black (ASTM D1937); an Individual Pellet Hardness Tester that measures the individual pellet crush strength and size of 10 to 50 pellets and reports maximum, minimum and other statistical data (ASTM D5230); a Portable Sieve Residue Tester, a portable test stand for determining the residue or contamination level (ASTM D1514); a Multiple Station Sieve Residue Tester with a stainless steel sink, made to order for two to five test stations with automated timers for wash time control (ASTM D1514); and a Void Volume Tester that measures the structure of carbon black using a 2 gram sample at compressions up to 27,000 psig. Consumables and accessories are also listed, including stainless steel OAN bowls in standard, grooved and water-cooled versions and stainless steel paddles for OAN testers (ASTM D2414).

Alongside equipment supply, Jaron Technologies provides individual sample testing for Individual Pellet Hardness, Bulk Density, Sieve Residue Pellet Size Distribution and Void Volume. The site states that the company owners have over 60 years experience in the Carbon Black Laboratory Test Equipment Area and in the Carbon Black Plant Operations area, and that the company has customers in North America, South America, Europe, Russia, Australia, China, India and Indonesia.
productFamilies: Stainless Steel Paddles for OAN testers

profiles.shortDescription: Safran Filtration Systems is a subsidiary of Safran Landing Systems and an expert in avionics and cabin air quality, engine filtration and energy generation equipment, providing solutions to clean fluids and protect facilities (including decontamination) in the aviation, space and defense industries. It develops and sells filtration systems providing optimised product life cycle and live information on coating evolution, with a wide range of solutions meeting needs such as gas blanketing, odour filters, oxygen generation and antibacterial function. Safran's 2016 Registration Document lists it among the corporate names adopted in 2016 and gives Sofrance as the original name.
fullDescription: Safran Filtration Systems is described on Safran's site as a subsidiary of Safran Landing Systems and an expert in avionics and cabin air quality, engine filtration and energy generation equipment, providing solutions to clean fluids and protect facilities (including decontamination) in the aviation, space and defense industries. Its industrial site is at 6-8 rue Maryse-Bastié ZI des Gannes 87800 Nexon, France.

Safran's glossary of company names in the 2016 Registration Document sets out the corporate names adopted in 2016 alongside the original names, and lists Safran Filtration Systems against the original name Sofrance.

The company states that it develops and sells filtration systems providing optimised product life cycle and live information on coating evolution, with a wide range of solutions meeting today and tomorrow needs such as gas blanketing, odour filters, oxygen generation and antibacterial function. It also presents itself as a depollution expert that contributes to environment protection and provides tailored filtration and separation solutions adapted to circuits characteristics, to the type and quantity of pollution while treating efficiently particles, fluids and gaz. Photographs published for the site are captioned fuel and oil filters, expertise laboratory: hydraulic filters, and air filters manufacturing for Airbus A350.

Safran states that, thanks to a strong quality focus, Safran Filtration Systems optimizes ownership, use and maintenance costs of its equipments from design and ensures after-sale support on more than 7 000 aircraft and 15 000 engines for 400 operators, airlines and repair shops. The key figures published for the site are 7300 m² in Nexon, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France and 172 employees, and the page also publishes the general terms and condition of sale for download.

profiles.shortDescription: RS Roman Seliger Armaturenfabrik GmbH is based in Norderstedt, Germany, and its acquisition by the Stäubli Group was announced on June 6th, 2018. The announcement states that for over 100 years Roman Seliger has been a specialist in the development of standard and safety dry-disconnect couplings, delivering solutions for the handling of all fluid media to its customers.
fullDescription: Stäubli Group announced the acquisition of RS Roman Seliger Armaturenfabrik GmbH, based in Norderstedt, Germany, in a press release datelined Pfäffikon, June 6th, 2018. The release states: "For over 100 years, Roman Seliger has been a specialist in the development of standard and safety dry-disconnect couplings, delivering solutions for the handling of all fluid media to its customers." It adds that the acquisition of Roman Seliger by Stäubli is in line with the company's successful growth strategy and that it also allows to join innovative forces in new complementary fields such as big diameter couplings, breakaway technologies and cryogenics.

The same release describes acquiring RS Roman Seliger Armaturenfabrik GmbH as a great opportunity to further increase Stäubli's product range by adding specialized solutions to its comprehensive portfolio, and states that all employees of the acquired business will join the Fluid Connector Division, while the factory in Norderstedt will become part of the global production network of Stäubli. André Lucchetti, Group Division Manager Fluid Connectors, is quoted as saying: "With Roman Seliger, we are strengthening our global position in the field of fluid connectors, extending our range to new applications such as cryogenics and market segments such as oil/gas as well as expanding our R&D capacity."

Rolf Strebel, CEO of Stäubli, is quoted as saying that Stäubli and Roman Seliger not only complement each other very well in terms of products but also share a long family tradition and common values. Dr. Jens Reppenhagen, who has been leading RS Roman Seliger Armaturenfabrik GmbH in the past and will continue to do so for the Stäubli unit in Norderstedt, states that the company "will profit greatly from this important step, securing a continued development for our employees and our range of high-quality products". Both parties have agreed to keep the transaction price confidential.

profiles.officialName: Industrial Technologies and Services LLC d/b/a Roots
formerNames: P. H. and F. M. Roots Company
profiles.shortDescription: Roots publishes a range of positive displacement blowers, centrifugal compressors and truck blowers. The company states that Roots has been a part of the United States industrial scene for over 170 years and that it operates in Connersville, Indiana. Its published applications include steel plants, food and chemical plants, water and wastewater treatment, paper and textile mills.
fullDescription: Roots states that the principle of the rotary lobe blower was discovered by two brothers, Francis and Philander Roots, while they were redesigning the main machinery driver in their woolen mill; running the machine dry revealed the device's ability to move air at a high rate, which the company describes as the first Roots rotary lobe blower. The history page records that at an exhibition in Paris in 1867 the Roots blower was granted the highest award for design, workmanship, material and efficiency prior to being patented in 1868, and that Roots went on to develop air and gas blowers for industries including steel plants, smelters, refineries, food and chemical plants, water and wastewater treatment, paper and textile mills.

The site sets out the ownership chain in the company's own words: the business originally started under the name "P. H. and F. M. Roots Company", merged in 1929 with the Connersville Blower Company under the control of the Stacy Engineering Company, was acquired by Dresser Industries in 1944, and then passed through Halliburton, Dresser Inc., GE in 2011, Colfax and its Howden group, and KPS in 2019; KPS sold Howden to Chart Corp in 2023 and "Chart Corp separated the Roots business which was integrated into the Ingersoll Rand family of brands in 2023." Roots adds that it continues "to this day to make high quality blower and compressor products with use across a wide variety of industries and applications" and that it operates in Connersville, Indiana. The standard terms of sale page defines Roots as Industrial Technologies and Services LLC d/b/a Roots.

The current product range published on the site is organised into PD blowers, centrifugal compressors and truck blowers, the last described as mobile vacuum blowers engineered for maximum CFM with minimal weight. Roots describes a positive displacement blower as designed to deliver a consistent air volume with each rotation regardless of changes in discharge pressure, with pressure ratings up to 18 PSI and vacuum capabilities down to 27"HgV. The published blower families are the URAI series, whose Universal RAI blower has rugged cast-iron construction, alloy steel timing gears, oversized bearings and a dual lubrication system; the RAM series, which integrates ductile iron impellers, gray iron casings and aluminum drive covers and uses cylindrical roller bearings and a hydrodynamic seal; the RCS series, offered for robust industrial use; the RAS and RGS rotary positive blowers; and the Roots Flo blower and vacuum group, listed together with the DVJ Whispair Exhauster. The centrifugal compressors are published as the OIB and H types.

profiles.shortDescription: ESQ is the equipment line carried by Elcom LLC, a Saint Petersburg company that states it is engaged in the production and supply of industrial equipment. Its catalogue lists general-purpose ESQ electric motors, the ESQ PR IEC(DIN) and ESQ PR GOST ranges, ESQ HT motors for drying chambers and fire-resistant ESQ FR motors. The same catalogue also covers pumps, gearboxes and geared motors, frequency converters and soft starters, low- and high-voltage equipment, bearings, heating and ventilation equipment and hoists.
fullDescription: ООО «Элком» states on its own site that it is engaged in the production and supply of industrial equipment, and its catalogue is organised into electric motors, pumps, low- and high-voltage equipment, frequency converters and soft starters, gearboxes and geared motors, bearings, heating equipment, ventilation, switchgear and hoists. The company publishes item counts for nine of these sections — electric motors, pumps, low- and high-voltage equipment, frequency converters and soft starters, gearboxes and geared motors, bearings, heating equipment, ventilation and hoists. Within the electric motor section the ESQ-branded ranges are listed as Электродвигатели ESQ, Электродвигатели ESQ PR IEC(DIN) and Электродвигатели ESQ PR GOST among the general-purpose motors, plus Электродвигатели для сушильных камер ESQ HT and Огнеупорные электродвигатели ESQ FR among the special motors. Neighbouring catalogue sections cover explosion-proof, petrochemical, mining, high-voltage, crane, single-phase and brake motors, as well as spare parts and components for motors.

The company states that its equipment is certified to Russian and international standards, that a warranty is provided on all supplied products, and that modern CAD systems and its own know-how are used in the manufacture and design of its products. It also offers technical consultation on equipment operation, setup and warranty service, work on customers' special projects, and a full project cycle on the basis of the equipment it supplies — from design and survey work and drafting of technical specifications through to commissioning and the fulfilment of warranty and service obligations. Configurators are published on the same site.

The published company details give the full name Общество с ограниченной ответственностью «Элком», short name ООО «Элком», ОГРН 1037808003507, ИНН 7804079187, КПП 781601001 and ОКПО 49016308, with the registered address 192102, Saint Petersburg, Vitebskaya Sortirovochnaya street 34, building 3. The company describes its purpose in terms of the success of each employee, partner and customer, and publishes its values, a bonus system and its contact number for enquiries.
productFamilies: Электродвигатели для сушильных камер ESQ HT

profiles.shortDescription: Schaffner is published by TE Connectivity as a brand that is now part of TE Connectivity, described as a leader and innovator in the EMC filters and power quality market with the broadest product range in the industry. Its products appear in TE's EMI and EMC solutions categories, including EMC filters, EMC chokes, power quality and custom EMI solutions. The named applications are motion and drives, robotics, industrial machinery, medical equipment, e-mobility and EV infrastructure, battery energy storage systems, and HVAC and climate solutions.
fullDescription: Schaffner is published on TE Connectivity's site as a brand that is now part of TE Connectivity. It is described as a leader and innovator in the EMC filters and power quality market, offering the broadest product range in the industry, and the combined product portfolio is said to allow a stronger value proposition to customers and partners through accelerated product innovation, global field engineering capabilities, and a manufacturing footprint that ensures the global supply chain resilience customers expect from their strategic suppliers.

In its own words, Schaffner provides its customers with electromagnetic solutions to operate their electronic systems reliably and efficiently, and states that it plays a vital role in building a sustainable and electrified society by shaping electrical power. The products are listed within TE's EMI and EMC solutions catalogue, whose categories include custom EMI solutions, EMC chokes, EMC filters, EMI/EMP connectors, EMI and EMC accessories, EMI shielding, IEC inlets, IEC power cords, power quality, pulse transformers and medical EMI and EMC solutions. Corcom is presented alongside Schaffner on the same page, with filter series that provide solutions to EMI or RFI signal issues, and the latest catalogue covering the Schaffner and Corcom portfolios is offered for download as Filter Series in English, Chinese and Japanese, together with the Schaffner Corcom Filter Selector chart.

The applications named for the range are motion and drives, robotics, industrial machinery, medical equipment, e-mobility and EV infrastructure, battery energy storage system, and HVAC and climate solutions. The stated purpose of the EMC and power quality products is to improve the reliability and efficiency of electrical systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Düsen-Schlick GmbH develops and manufactures nozzles and nozzle systems for spray and atomization processes. Its portfolio covers two-substance, three- and four-substance nozzles, pressure (single-substance) nozzles, tank-cleaning nozzles, dosing systems and high-pressure EHS nozzles rated up to 3000 bar. The company states that most of its products are custom-made and that its solutions serve the pharmaceutical and food industries as well as environmental technology, industrial processes and agricultural applications.
fullDescription: Düsen-Schlick GmbH describes itself as an internationally leading technology company based in Untersiemau near Coburg, Germany. It presents itself as a family-owned traditional company that has been a pioneer for decades in the development of innovative atomization solutions for the pharmaceutical and food industries as well as environmental technology, working under the motto "Living for Solutions". The company states that most of its products are custom-made and that its nozzle solutions cover industrial processes, agricultural applications and special technical areas, and its imprint gives the site operator and address as Düsen-Schlick GmbH, Hutstraße 4, 96253 Untersiemau/Coburg, Germany, registered at Coburg Local Court under HRB 2810.

The SCHLICK product portfolio is organised by nozzle principle. Two-substance nozzles use a second medium — compressed air, gas or steam — to atomise highly viscous liquids and suspensions, and are offered in internal- and external-mixing versions. Three- and four-substance nozzles are used where several liquids must be atomised through a single nozzle, for example in combustion or chemical mixing processes. Pressure nozzles, also called single-substance nozzles, atomise using the liquid's own energy without additional compressed air or steam. The range is completed by spring-operated and automatic rotating tank-cleaning nozzles, dosing systems for installation in spray systems with pulsed operation, and the EHS high-pressure product line rated at pressures of up to 3000 bar for cleaning tanks or containers, treating surfaces, renovating concrete and deburring, as well as cutting and carving processes.

The company names several of its own developments on its site. Its Anti-Bearding Technology centres on the SCHLICK Anti-Bearding Cap (ABC), which replaces the geometry of conventional flat jet nozzles with a rounded orifice shape that reduces turbulence and prevents circulating dust particles from building up on the nozzle during coating, and which is offered in nano, laboratory and production sizes as 951 S24 NANO ABC, 970 S75 ABC and 930 S35 ABC. The Professional Coating Arm (PCA) consists of individual linkable blocks, each with one nozzle, operating on the manifold principle and developed for demanding applications such as tablet coating and sugar coating, while the Spray-unit connects the supply unit and the nozzle by screw thread, clamp connection, push-in connector or customised solutions. Testing and development are carried out at the SCHLICK Test & Research Center (STRC), whose over 500 m2 premises hold modular and flexible test rigs that simulate complex spray and coating situations and measure parameters including drop size and speed and spray distribution, with tests and measurements carried out using the customer's own substances and samples. The company states that since May 2025 EHS products, high-performance nozzles for industrial applications, have been part of the SCHLICK portfolio, and it offers a product finder for submitting a specific request based on an existing article number.

profiles.shortDescription: Seagate Technology LLC publishes a data-storage product directory organised by device type — external and internal hard drives, external and internal SSDs, enterprise hard drives and SSDs, and data storage systems — and by category, from personal storage devices and gaming storage devices to Creative Professional, network attached storage, video analytics, and cloud, edge and data center storage. Named drive lines documented on its product pages include Exos, Nytro, IronWolf, SkyHawk, BarraCuda, FireCuda and Ultra Touch.
fullDescription: Seagate's product directory is organised by device type — External Hard Drives, Internal Hard Drives, External SSDs, Internal SSDs, Enterprise Hard Drives & SSDs and Data Storage Systems — and by category: Personal Storage Devices, Gaming Storage Devices, Creative Professional, Network Attached Storage (NAS), Video Analytics, Cloud, Edge, & Data Center, and Hyperscale & Cloud. The same page's navigation lists Big Data Analytics (AI/ML) and High Performance Computing (HPC) under By Use Case, Private Cloud and Hyperscale & Cloud under By Environment, and Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security and Telecommunications under By Industry. Its Perspectives menu names Storage for the AI Era, Why Areal Density Matters, Composable Infrastructure and the Decarbonizing Data Report, and its Data Storage Innovations menu names the Mozaic Platform, MACH.2 Multi-Actuator Hard Drives and Seagate Secure.

On the enterprise page Seagate presents Exos Enterprise Hard Drives and Nytro Series SSDs, states that Seagate enterprise drives such as the Exos® series are built to handle continuous 24×7 operation, and lists the Nytro 1361 Series, Nytro 5350 Series and Nytro 5550 Series alongside Mozaic, described as mass-capacity storage at unprecedented areal densities of 3TB/disk and beyond. The NAS page describes Seagate IronWolf® as a NAS-specific drive optimized for reliability, longevity and performance under constant use, and documents IronWolf Health Management (IHM) as a feature integrated into Seagate IronWolf and IronWolf Pro NAS drives.

The video and analytics page names Seagate SkyHawk™ hard drives as dedicated video and analytics hard drives designed for continuous, 24×7 operation and presents SkyHawk Video Hard Drives for surveillance systems; its related products also include IronWolf NAS Hard Drives, the BarraCuda 3.5-inch hard drive for desktop computing storage, and the Ultra Touch External Hard Drive covering Ultra Touch external hard drives and external SSDs. The gaming page names the Seagate FireCuda® 530, with read speeds of up to 7,300MB/s and write speeds of up to 6,900MB/s, and Seagate BarraCuda®, with speeds up to 7200 RPM providing faster load times and smoother gameplay. The hard drives page states that Seagate IronWolf® and SkyHawk™ hard drives come with three-year warranties, while SkyHawk AI, IronWolf Pro and Exos® hard drives feature a five-year warranty.

The corporate entity behind the site is Seagate Technology LLC, named in the site footer and in the company's privacy statement, which states that Seagate Technology LLC is located at 47488 Kato Road, Fremont, CA 94538, USA. The Our Story page states that for more than four decades Seagate has helped move technology forward by building the infrastructure that makes data usable, accessible and enduring, and that the company has a presence in over 30 countries with customers in nearly every corner of the world.

profiles.shortDescription: Drumag GmbH is a German fluid technology manufacturer based in Bad Säckingen in South Baden. It develops and produces pneumatic and hydropneumatic actuators, together with valves, cylinders, compressed air treatment components, compressors and proportional control equipment. The company states that it is part of the Valeta Group and lists 15,000 standard products in the range alongside its tailor-made customer solutions.
fullDescription: Drumag GmbH gives 1951 as its company foundation year and its address as Glarnerstr. 2, 79713 Bad Säckingen. The company states that, as part of the Valeta Group, Drumag specializes in the development and production of pneumatic and hydropneumatic actuators, and that the necessary expertise is found under one roof in Bad Säckingen in South Baden. It describes its field as fluid technology automation solutions (pneumatics and hydropneumatics) and states over 100 years of experience and expertise in drive technologies. The Company group menu on the same site lists Valeta, EPH Elektronik, Sirag and Uniprod.

The company organises its offering around four applications — Movement, Control, Dosing and Measurement — and supports customers from the design stage and the testing of prototypes to the production of small series. Its published figures list 1,000 previous customer projects, 3,000 development projects implemented to date and 15,000 standard products in the range, which it presents as working especially in combination with its tailor-made customer solutions. The site's Industry solutions menu lists Energy Technology, Conveyor Technology, Grinding Technology and Packaging Technology, and the company page states many years of experience in the agricultural, energy, grinding and packaging technology sectors.

The product list on the Movement application page includes pneumatic valves such as the 10 mm Nanovalves – B Series, 15 mm Microvalves – A Series, 2/2 – 3/2 Miniature pilot valves – AA/AB Series, COMBOBOX valves 5/2, 5/3, 3/2 + 3/2 way – PS Series, ISO 5599/1 Valves – BE/BE12 Series, MIXED threaded valves 5/2 – AC Series, Threaded spool valves UNIVERSAL 3/2 – 5/2 – 5/3 – CL/CM Series and Poppet valves for compressed air and vacuum 2/2 – 3/2 – AF/AG Series; cylinders including the M Microcylinder, OV Oval cylinders, RT Telescopic cylinders – 2/3 stages, S Rodless cylinder and W Short-stroke cylinders; hydraulic cylinders in the ZU series, ZAR series, ZHSS series and ZU 250 series; and hydropneumatic equipment such as the HPE and HPL-B hydropneumatic feed units, the HPU pressure intensifier, the HPW air-oil actuator and the HPZL hydropneumatic cylinder. The same list covers the ERC3, RCD and RCP5 electric cylinders, the DSO-HPE rotary actuator, oil-free diaphragm, piston, rotary and wobble piston compressors and vacuum pumps, compressed air filters, regulators and oil nebulizers, SDAT series compressed air dryers and the X Series compressed air dryer, high-performance silencers, and the RIBA proportional controller.

profiles.shortDescription: System Plast supplies steel and plastic conveying chains, modular plastic belts, conveying components, custom machined plastic and mounted bearings. Its products page groups the range under Bearings and Conveying and names the ModSort® divert and transfer module, Nolu® plastics and ValuGuide® conveying components. The brand is part of Regal Rexnord's Power Transmission Solutions business unit, with head offices in Telgate, Bergamo, Italy.
fullDescription: Founded in 1985, System Plast® S.p.A is described on the brand's history page as a global supplier of quality steel and plastic conveying chains, modular plastic belts, conveying components, custom machined plastic and mounted bearings. The same page records that System Plast acquired USA-based Solus Innovations, manufacturer of Valu Guide® conveying components and Nolu® machined plastic, in 2005, and that System Plast was acquired by Power Transmission Solutions® in 2009 and is now part of the Power Transmission Solutions business unit. The contact page gives the current entity twice as SYSTEM PLAST S.r.l., with Head Offices at Via Guareschi n° 2, 24060 Telgate – Bergamo and further Offices at Via San Giuseppe n° 54, 24060 Telgate – Bergamo.

The brand page states that the System Plast® brand is a global leader in high quality plastic conveyor chains, modular plastic belts, and industry-leading conveying components, and that it also has manufacturing and service centers located strategically around the world. It describes a focus on assisting customers to achieve sustainability while lowering their total cost of ownership through continuous improvement activities, adds that Power Transmission Solutions™ continues support for this with strong technical capabilities and resources, and states that this has been accomplished by providing conveying components solutions for diverse material handling applications. The products page groups the range under Bearings — modular bearing assemblies for harsh wash down environments often found in food and beverage processing — and Conveying, covering high-quality steel and plastic flat top conveyor chains, modular plastic belts and industry-leading ValuGuide® conveying components, with applications including food and beverage packaging, package handling and other unit material handling.

Featured product families include the ModSort® Divert & Transfer Module, presented as a low-noise, low voltage modular transfer/diverter station that can easily integrate with new or existing systems, eliminating the need for a lift, pneumatics, or Z-direction position feedback devices; Nolu® Plastics, made with Regal's exclusive compounds of UHMWPE and solid lubricants/unique ingredients and offered under the featured component brands Nolu-S™, Nolu-SR™ and Nolu-SX™; and System Plast® conveyor chain return rollers, made from impact resistant material, highly resistant to chemicals and self lubricating, with a urethane sleeve or ribbed under cover option. The ValuGuide® page presents ValuGuide® products as dense patterns of free moving beads or rollers that create a durable low friction guiding surface for areas of a conveying line where containers have trouble moving smoothly, and lists three branded products: the SpeedSet™ Side Guide Adjustment System, whose brackets provide preset conveyor guide rail adjustability; the ValuFlex™ Serpentine Wear Strip System; and ValuTrac™ Conveyor Components, whose straight and corner modules are designed to guide side flexing steel and plastic conveyor chains. The brand section also documents System Plast® Wear Strips, including Nolu-S wear strips and guides made with a blend of UHMW and other dry lubricants, the System Plast® Extra Plus Stainless Steel Chain And Hb Pin, System Plast® Nolu Clean Bearings For Food Processing, and the Smart Guide and SPEC Configurator selection tools, while its news list announces the ModSort® Trident Three-Way Sortation System and the System Plast® iCOF® Condition Monitoring Device.

profiles.shortDescription: In 1899 Franz Klöckner founded a manufacturing company in Cologne, Germany for electrical switching devices; the company became Klöckner-Moeller in the 1940s and then Moeller GmbH in 1999. Eaton acquired the Moeller Group in 2008, a manufacturer of components for residential building applications, circuit protection and industrial controls for machinery applications in Europe.
fullDescription: Eaton's heritage page for Klöckner-Moeller records that in 1899 Franz Klöckner founded a manufacturing company in Cologne, Germany for electrical switching devices. Hein Moeller joined the company in 1911 and developed the first three-phase oil-insulated contactor in 1912.

According to the same page, the company became Klöckner-Moeller in the 1940s and then became Moeller GmbH in 1999 to celebrate its centennial. In the 1990s the Moeller Test Laboratory in Bonn was the first German laboratory to be accredited for industrial low-voltage devices and systems.

Eaton acquired the Moeller Group in 2008, a leading manufacturer of components for residential building applications, circuit protection and industrial controls for machinery applications in Europe. On the same page Eaton describes itself as an intelligent power management company.

profiles.shortDescription: SAMOA Industrial, S.A. is a Spanish manufacturer of pumps, equipment and systems for complex fluids handling. Its published catalogue is organised as lubrication equipment for lubrication and vehicle maintenance applications, process pumps for fluid transfer in industrial processes, applied industrial fluid solutions for paint spraying and viscous fluid application, and spare parts. The global headquarters is in Gijón, Spain.
fullDescription: SAMOA Industrial describes itself as a 3rd generation family business dedicated to manufacturing pumps, equipment and systems for complex fluids handling. It started its activity in 1958 in Gijón, Spain, manufacturing rivets and grease nipples, and in 1960 it began to manufacture manual grease pumps and accessories for industrial lubrication, which gave rise to the current Lubrication Equipment division. In 1968 it embarked on the manufacture of electro-hydraulic vehicle lifts until 1972, when it decided to stop production and start manufacturing workshop furniture, after which it focused on the development of lubrication pumps and accessories and launched its first pneumatic grease gun in 1980. Throughout the 1980s and 1990s it expanded its range of products for lubrication and vehicle maintenance with new pneumatic oil and grease pumps, hose reels, waste oil recovery devices and other accessories, and in 2013 it completed the lubrication equipment portfolio with a Heavy Duty range for industrial and heavy vehicle applications.

The company began exploring the industrial business in 2005 through the acquisition of an innovative air operated double diaphragm pump concept, its patent and its development, which was the beginning of the Process Pumps Division encompassing all products for fluid transfer in industrial processes, with main applications in tank loading and unloading, batching and mixing, coating, filling and re-circulation, sumping, dewatering, fluid filtration and general transfer. In 2010 SAMOA launched its first air operated double diaphragm pump under the name Directflo, and it continued to develop and improve these pumps until completing a range with different models available in various sizes and materials. In 2018 SAMOA made a significant entry into the Oil & Gas sector with the launch of ultra-high pressure pneumatic piston pumps and air operated double diaphragm pumps, and since the late 1990s it has been developing electronic systems and software for fluid stock management and the electronic control of sensorized pumps and equipment.

SAMOA initiated commercial relations outside Spain in the 1960s, exporting to Latin America, Europe and North Africa, and states that this has led to selling its products in more than 110 countries. In 1993 it opened subsidiaries in the USA (SAMSON Corporation), England (SAMOA Ltd) and France (SAMOA Sarl), and it entered the German market in 2000 with the opening of SAMOA-Hallbauer GmbH, which later became SAMOA GmbH. As a consequence of its strategy to penetrate the industry of off-set inks it acquired two leading pumps and systems manufacturers, Hydrair in England in 2008 and Betz in Germany in 2016, both of which were integrated by inheriting the SAMOA brand, and in 2019 it acquired LARIUS, an Italian manufacturer of equipment for paint spraying and application of viscous fluids in manufacturing processes, giving rise to the new Applied Industrial Fluid Solutions division. It had earlier acquired the compressor manufacturer PUSKA in 1996 and sold it in 2003, focusing solely on fluid management.

The product site publishes the range as lubrication equipment, process pumps, applied industrial fluid solutions and spare parts. The lubrication equipment section is presented as covering high-quality pumps, reels, valves, meters, waste fluid recovery units and fluid inventory control systems, and lists pneumatic piston pumps, pneumatic diaphragm pumps, hand-held equipment, electric pumps, reels, dispensing valves, mobile units and packages, electronic fluid management systems, waste fluid management, accessories and spare parts. The process pumps line includes pneumatic diaphragm pumps and piston pumps, while the applied industrial fluid solutions line is offered for industries such as automotive, offshore & marine, energy, furniture, white goods & electronic appliances, and construction.
